name: SSH Liaison
shortDescription: Provides secure remote server access and command execution through SSH connections with persistent shell sessions.

rawRecord.name: SSH Liaison
rawRecord.short_description: Provides secure remote server access and command execution through SSH connections with persistent shell sessions.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Enables stateful SSH connections where environment state and working directory persist between commands. Supports both SSH config file aliases and direct credential-based connections with automatic key/password authentication fallback. Includes tools for establishing connections, running commands, and reading remote log files.
